Suri Cruise Legally Drops Father Tom Cruise's Surname

Suri Cruise, daughter of actors Tom Cruise and Katie Holmes, has legally dropped her father's surname. The change was reportedly made when she turned 18. While the specific reasons for the name change were not detailed in the coverage, it follows her parents' divorce in 2012. Suri Cruise is pursuing higher education.
